items.name: Dark deploy
items.description: A graphite terminal on a slowly drifting grid types `npm run deploy`, fills an uneven progress bar, ticks off three checks after a spinner and ends on a READY badge and a live URL. The header's lamp pulses amber while the deploy runs and turns green at the end.

items.name: Agent session
items.description: An AI coding agent's session laid out as a step timeline: the request types in after an `ask` tag, then plan, open and patch steps arrive on a growing spine with right-aligned results. A tinted diff follows, then a `run` spinner resolves to '12 passed' and the session closes on `done`.

items.name: Paper tests
items.description: A cream window with an ink header and a hard offset ink shadow, on a warm grid, runs `npm test`: three PASS badges stream in, then a red FAIL with the failing assertion and the summary.

items.name: Amber console
items.description: A full-frame amber CRT powers on from a bright line, types RUN DIAGNOSTICS and prints dotted status rows, a progress bar, a WARN badge and a summary, with scanlines, grain and a rolling band.

items.name: Green console
items.description: The CRT console in green phosphor: a batch job types in, dotted rows fill, a progress bar runs and a HOLD badge flags 12 records before the job ends.

items.name: Blue console
items.description: The CRT console in blue phosphor: a telemetry poll lists buoy readings, a sync bar fills, one buoy reports LOST and a summary line closes it.
